name: PivotTable
description: Represents a PivotTable report on a worksheet.
remarks: The PivotTable object is a member of the PivotTables collection. The PivotTables collection contains all the PivotTable objects on a single worksheet. Because PivotTable report programming can be complex, it's generally easiest to record PivotTable report actions and then revise the recorded code.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: ColumnFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable field (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the fields (a PivotFields object) that are currently shown as column fields. Read-only.

properties.name: ColumnGrand
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report shows grand totals for columns. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ColumnRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range that contains the column area in the PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: DataBodyRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range of values in a PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: DataFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable field (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the fields (a PivotFields object) that are currently shown as data fields. Read-only.

properties.name: DataLabelRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range that contains the labels for the data fields in the PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: HasAutoFormat
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report is automatically formatted when it's refreshed or when fields are moved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HiddenFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable field (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the fields (a PivotFields object) that are currently not shown as row, column, page, or data fields. Read-only.

properties.name: InnerDetail
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the field that will be shown as detail when the ShowDetail property is True for the innermost row or column field. Read/write String.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value representing the name of the object.

properties.name: PageFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable field (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the fields (a PivotFields object) that are currently showing as page fields. Read-only.

properties.name: PageRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range that contains the page area in the PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: PageRangeCells
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents only the cells in the specified PivotTable report that contain the page fields and item drop-down lists.

properties.name: RefreshDate
properties.description: Returns the date on which the PivotTable report was last refreshed. Read-only Date.

properties.name: RefreshName
properties.description: Returns the name of the person who last refreshed the PivotTable report data. Read-only String.

properties.name: RowFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single field in a PivotTable report (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the fields (a PivotFields object) that are currently showing as row fields. Read-only.

properties.name: RowGrand
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report shows grand totals for rows. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RowRange
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range including the row area on the PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: SaveData
properties.description: True if data for the PivotTable report is saved with the workbook. False if only the report definition is saved. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SourceData
properties.description: Returns the data source for the PivotTable report, as shown in the following table. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: TableRange1
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing the entire PivotTable report, but doesn't include page fields. Read-only.

properties.name: TableRange2
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range containing the entire PivotTable report, including page fields. Read-only.

properties.name: Value
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the name of the PivotTable report.

properties.name: VisibleFields
properties.description: Returns an object that represents either a single field in a PivotTable report (a PivotField object) or a collection of all the visible fields (a PivotFields object). Visible fields are shown as row, column, page or data fields. Read-only.

properties.name: CacheIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the index number of the PivotTable cache. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DisplayErrorString
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report displays a custom error string in cells that contain errors. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayNullString
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report displays a custom string in cells that contain null values. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableDrilldown
properties.description: True if drilldown is enabled. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableFieldDialog
properties.description: True if the PivotTable Field dialog box is available when the user double-clicks the PivotTable field. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableWizard
properties.description: True if the PivotTable Wizard is available. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ErrorString
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the string displayed in cells that contain errors when the DisplayErrorString property is True.

properties.name: ManualUpdate
properties.description: True if the PivotTable report is recalculated only at the user's request. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MergeLabels
properties.description: True if the specified PivotTable report's outer-row item, column item, subtotal, and grand total labels use merged cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NullString
properties.description: Returns or sets the string displayed in cells that contain null values when the DisplayNullString property is True. The default value is an empty string (""). Read/write String.

properties.name: PivotFormulas
properties.description: Returns a PivotFormulas object that represents the collection of formulas for the specified PivotTable report. Read-only.

properties.name: SubtotalHiddenPageItems
properties.description: True if hidden page field items in the PivotTable report are included in row and column subtotals, block totals, and grand totals. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PageFieldOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the order in which page fields are added to the PivotTable report's layout. Can be one of the following XlOrder constants: xlDownThenOver or xlOverThenDown. The default constant is xlDownThenOver. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PageFieldStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style used in the bound page field area. The default value is a null string (no style is applied by default). Read/write String.

properties.name: PageFieldWrapCount
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of page fields in each column or row in the PivotTable report. Read/write Long.

properties.name: PreserveFormatting
properties.description: True if formatting is preserved when the report is refreshed or recalculated by operations such as pivoting, sorting, or changing page field items.

properties.name: PivotSelection
properties.description: Returns or sets the PivotTable selection in standard PivotTable report selection format. Read/write String.

properties.name: SelectionMode
properties.description: Returns or sets the PivotTable report structured selection mode. Read/write XlPTSelectionMode.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Returns or sets a string saved with the PivotTable report. Read/write String.

properties.name: VacatedStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style applied to cells vacated when the PivotTable report is refreshed. The default value is a null string (no style is applied by default). Read/write String.

properties.name: PrintTitles
properties.description: True if the print titles for the worksheet are set based on the PivotTable report. False if the print titles for the worksheet are used. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CubeFields
properties.description: Returns the CubeFields collection. Each CubeField object contains the properties of the cube field element. Read-only.

properties.name: GrandTotalName
properties.description: Returns or sets the text string label that is displayed in the grand total column or row heading in the specified PivotTable report. The default value is the string Grand Total. Read/write String.

properties.name: SmallGrid
properties.description: True if Microsoft Excel uses a grid that's two cells wide and two cells deep for a newly created PivotTable report. False if Excel uses a blank stencil outline. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: RepeatItemsOnEachPrintedPage
properties.description: True if row, column, and item labels appear on the first row of each page when the specified PivotTable report is printed. False if labels are printed only on the first page. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TotalsAnnotation
properties.description: True if an asterisk (\) is displayed next to each subtotal and grand total value in the specified PivotTable report if the report is based on an OLAP data source. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean**.

properties.name: PivotSelectionStandard
properties.description: Returns or sets a String indicating the PivotTable selection in standard PivotTable report format using English (United States) settings. Read/write.

properties.name: DataPivotField
properties.description: Returns a PivotField object that represents all the data fields in a PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: EnableDataValueEditing
properties.description: True to disable the alert for when the user overwrites values in the data area of the PivotTable. True also allows the user to change data values that previously could not be changed. The default value is False. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MDX
properties.description: Returns a String indicating the Multidimensional Expression (MDX) that would be sent to the provider to populate the current PivotTable view. Read-only.

properties.name: ViewCalculatedMembers
properties.description: When set to True (default), calculated members for Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) PivotTables can be viewed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CalculatedMembers
properties.description: Returns a CalculatedMembers collection representing all the calculated members and calculated measures for an OLAP PivotTable.

properties.name: DisplayImmediateItems
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that indicates whether items in the row and column areas are visible when the data area of the PivotTable is empty. Set this property to False to hide the items in the row and column areas when the data area of the PivotTable is empty. The default value is True.

properties.name: EnableFieldList
properties.description: False to disable the ability to display the field list for the PivotTable. If the field list was already being displayed, it disappears. The default value is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: VisualTotals
properties.description: True (default) to enable Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) PivotTables to retotal after an item has been hidden from view. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowPageMultipleItemLabel
properties.description: When set to True (default), "(Multiple Items)" will appear in the PivotTable cell on the worksheet whenever items are hidden and an aggregate of non-hidden items is shown in the PivotTable view. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Version
properties.description: Returns an XlPivotTableVersionList value that represents the Microsoft Excel version number.

properties.name: DisplayEmptyRow
properties.description: Returns True when the non-empty MDX keyword is included in the query to the OLAP provider for the category axis. The OLAP provider will not return empty rows in the result set. Returns False when the non-empty keyword is omitted. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayEmptyColumn
properties.description: Returns True when the non-empty MDX keyword is included in the query to the OLAP provider for the value axis. The OLAP provider will not return empty columns in the result set. Returns False when the non-empty keyword is omitted. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PivotColumnAxis
properties.description: Returns a PivotAxis object representing the entire column axis. Read-only PivotAxis.

properties.name: PivotRowAxis
properties.description: Returns a PivotAxis object representing the entire row axis. Read-only PivotAxis.

properties.name: ShowDrillIndicators
properties.description: The ShowDrillIndicators property is used for toggling the display of drill indicators in the PivotTable. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PrintDrillIndicators
properties.description: Specifies whether drill indicators are printed with the PivotTable. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayMemberPropertyTooltips
properties.description: Controls whether to display member properties in tooltips. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayContextTooltips
properties.description: Controls whether tooltips are displayed for PivotTable cells. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CompactRowIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets the indent increment for PivotItems when compact row layout form is turned on. Read/write.

properties.name: LayoutRowDefault
properties.description: This property specifies the layout settings for PivotFields when they are added to the PivotTable for the first time. Read/write XlLayoutRowType.

properties.name: DisplayFieldCaptions
properties.description: Controls whether filter buttons and PivotField captions for rows and columns are displayed in the grid. Read/write.

properties.name: ActiveFilters
properties.description: Indicates the currently active filter in the specified PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: InGridDropZones
properties.description: This property is used to toggle in-grid drop zones for a PivotTable object. In some cases, it also affects the layout of the PivotTable. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: TableStyle2
properties.description: The TableStyle2 property specifies the PivotTable style currently applied to the PivotTable. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleLastColumn
properties.description: Returns or sets if the last column is displayed for the specified PivotTable object. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleRowStripes
properties.description: The ShowTableStyleRowStripes property displays banded rows in which even rows are formatted differently from odd rows. This makes PivotTables easier to read. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleColumnStripes
properties.description: The ShowTableStyleColumnStripes property displays banded columns in which even columns are formatted differently from odd columns. This makes PivotTables easier to read. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleRowHeaders
properties.description: The ShowTableStyleRowHeaders property is set to True if the row headers should be displayed in the PivotTable. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowTableStyleColumnHeaders
properties.description: The ShowTableStyleColumnHeaders property is set to True if the column headers should be displayed in the PivotTable. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AllowMultipleFilters
properties.description: Sets or retrieves a value that indicates whether a PivotField can have multiple filters applied to it at the same time. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: CompactLayoutRowHeader
properties.description: Specifies the caption that is displayed in the row header of a PivotTable when in compact row layout form. Read/write String.

properties.name: CompactLayoutColumnHeader
properties.description: Specifies the caption that is displayed in the column header of a PivotTable when in compact row layout form. Read/write String.

properties.name: FieldListSortAscending
properties.description: Controls the sort order of fields in the PivotTable Field List. When this property is set to True, the fields are sorted in ascending order. When it is set to False, the fields are sorted in data source order. Read/write.

properties.name: SortUsingCustomLists
properties.description: The SortUsingCustomLists property controls whether custom lists are used for sorting items of fields, both initially when the PivotField is initialized and the PivotItems are ordered by their captions, and later when the user applies a sort. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Location
properties.description: Gets or sets a String that represents the top-left cell in the body of the specified PivotTable object. Read/write.

properties.name: EnableWriteback
properties.description: Returns or sets whether writing back to the data source is enabled for the specified PivotTable. The default value is False. Read/write.

properties.name: Allocation
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to run an UPDATE CUBE statement for each cell that is edited, or only when the user chooses to calculate changes when performing what-if analysis on a PivotTable based on an OLAP data source. Read/write.

properties.name: AllocationValue
properties.description: Returns or sets the value to allocate when performing what-if analysis on a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source. Read/write.

properties.name: AllocationMethod
properties.description: Returns or sets the method to use to allocate values when performing what-if analysis on a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source. Read/write.

properties.name: AllocationWeightExpression
properties.description: Returns or sets the MDX weight expression to use when performing what-if analysis on a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source. Read/write.

properties.name: ChangeList
properties.description: Returns the PivotTableChangeList collection that represents the list of changes that have been made to the specified PivotTable based on an OLAP data source. Read-only.

properties.name: Slicers
properties.description: Returns the Slicers collection for the specified PivotTable. Read-only.

properties.name: AlternativeText
properties.description: Returns or sets the descriptive (alternative) text string for the specified PivotTable. Read/write.

properties.name: Summary
properties.description: Returns or sets the description associated with the alternative text string for the specified PivotTable. Read/write.

properties.name: VisualTotalsForSets
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to include filtered items in the totals of named sets for the specified PivotTable. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowValuesRow
properties.description: Returns or sets whether the values row is displayed. Read/write.

properties.name: CalculatedMembersInFilters
properties.description: Returns or sets whether to evaluate calculated members from OLAP servers in filters. Read/write.

properties.name: Hidden
properties.description: Checks whether the PivotTable exists at the worksheet level. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: PivotChart
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the standalone PivotChart for the specified hidden PivotTable report. Read-only.

methods.name: AddFields
methods.signature: AddFields([RowFields As Variant], [ColumnFields As Variant], [PageFields As Variant], [AddToTable As Variant]) As Variant
methods.description: Adds row, column, and page fields to a PivotTable report or PivotChart report.

parameters.name: RowFields
parameters.description: Specifies a field name (or an array of field names) to be added as rows or added to the category axis.

parameters.name: ColumnFields
parameters.description: Specifies a field name (or an array of field names) to be added as columns or added to the series axis.

parameters.name: PageFields
parameters.description: Specifies a field name (or an array of field names) to be added as pages or added to the page area.

parameters.name: AddToTable
parameters.description: Applies only to PivotTable reports. True to add the specified fields to the report (none of the existing fields are replaced). False to replace existing fields with the new fields. The default value is False.

methods.name: ShowPages
methods.description: Creates a new PivotTable report for each item in the page field. Each new report is created on a new worksheet.

parameters.name: PageField
parameters.description: A string that names a single page field in the report.

methods.name: PivotFields
methods.description: Returns an object that represents either a single PivotTable field (a PivotField object) or a collection of both the visible and hidden fields (a PivotFields object) in the PivotTable report. Read-only.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or number of the field to be returned.

methods.name: RefreshTable
methods.description: Refreshes the PivotTable report from the source data. Returns True if it's successful.

methods.name: CalculatedFields
methods.description: Returns a CalculatedFields collection that represents all the calculated fields in the specified PivotTable report. Read-only.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns the value for the data filed in a PivotTable.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Describes a single cell in the PivotTable report, using syntax similar to the PivotSelect method or the PivotTable report references in calculated item formulas.

methods.name: ListFormulas
methods.description: Creates a list of calculated PivotTable items and fields on a separate worksheet.

methods.name: PivotCache
methods.description: Returns a PivotCache object that represents the cache for the specified PivotTable report. Read-only.

methods.name: PivotTableWizard
methods.signature: PivotTableWizard([SourceType As Variant], [SourceData As Variant], [TableDestination As Variant], [TableName As Variant], [RowGrand As Variant], [ColumnGrand As Variant], [SaveData As Variant], [HasAutoFormat As Variant], [AutoPage As Variant], [Reserved As Variant], [BackgroundQuery As Variant], [OptimizeCache As Variant], [PageFieldOrder As Variant], [PageFieldWrapCount As Variant], [ReadData As Variant], [Connection As Variant])
methods.description: Creates and returns a PivotTable object. This method doesn't display the PivotTable Wizard. This method isn't available for OLE DB data sources. Use the Add method to add a PivotTable cache, and then create a PivotTable report based on the cache.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description: An XlPivotTableSourceType value that represents the source of the report data. If you specify this argument, you must also specify _SourceData_. If _SourceType_ and _SourceData_ are omitted, Microsoft Excel assumes that the source type is xlDatabase, and the source data comes from the named range Database. If this named range doesn't exist, Excel uses the current region if the current selection is in a range of more than 10 cells that contain data. If this isn't true, this method will fail.

parameters.name: SourceData
parameters.description: The data for the new report. Can be a Range object, an array of ranges, or a text constant that represents the name of another report. For an external database, _SourceData_ is an array of strings containing the SQL query string, where each element is up to 255 characters in length. You should use the _Connection_ argument to specify the ODBC connection string. For compatibility with earlier versions of Excel, _SourceData_ can be a two-element array. The first element is the connection string specifying the ODBC source for the data. The second element is the SQL query string used to get the data. If you specify _SourceData_, you must also specify _SourceType_. If the active cell is inside the _SourceData_ range, you must specify _TableDestination_ as well.

parameters.name: TableDestination
parameters.description: A Range object specifying where the report should be placed on the worksheet. If this argument is omitted, the report is placed at the active cell.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: A string that specifies the name of the new report.

parameters.name: RowGrand
parameters.description: True to show grand totals for rows in the report.

parameters.name: ColumnGrand
parameters.description: True to show grand totals for columns in the report.

parameters.name: SaveData
parameters.description: True to save data with the report. False to save only the report definition.

parameters.name: HasAutoFormat
parameters.description: True to have Excel automatically format the report when it's refreshed or when fields are moved.

parameters.name: AutoPage
parameters.description: Valid only if _SourceType_ is xlConsolidation. True to have Excel create a page field for the consolidation. If _AutoPage_ is False, you must create the page field or fields.

parameters.name: Reserved
parameters.description: Not used by Excel.

parameters.name: BackgroundQuery
parameters.description: True to have Excel perform queries for the report asynchronously (in the background). The default value is False.

parameters.name: OptimizeCache
parameters.description: True to optimize the PivotTable cache when it's constructed. The default value is False.

parameters.name: PageFieldOrder
parameters.description: The order in which page fields are added to the PivotTable report's layout. Can be one of the following XlOrder constants: xlDownThenOver (default) or xlOverThenDown.

parameters.name: PageFieldWrapCount
parameters.description: The number of page fields in each column or row in the PivotTable report. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: ReadData
parameters.description: True to create a PivotTable cache that contains all records from the external database; this cache can be very large. If _ReadData_ is False, you can set some of the fields as server-based page fields before the data is actually read.

parameters.name: Connection
parameters.description: A string that contains ODBC settings that allow Excel to connect to an ODBC data source. The connection string has the form ODBC;<connection string>. This argument overrides any previous setting for the PivotCache object's Connection property.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the PivotTable report.

methods.name: AddDataField
methods.signature: AddDataField(Field As Object, [Caption As Variant], [Function As Variant]) As PivotField
methods.description: Adds a data field to a PivotTable report. Returns a PivotField object that represents the new data field.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: The unique field on the server. If the source data is Online Analytical Processing (OLAP), the unique field is a cube field. If the source data is non-OLAP (non-OLAP source data), the unique field is a PivotTable field.

parameters.name: Caption
parameters.description: The label used in the PivotTable report to identify this data field.

parameters.name: Function
parameters.description: The function performed in the added data field.

methods.name: CreateCubeFile
methods.signature: CreateCubeFile(File As String, [Measures As Variant], [Levels As Variant], [Members As Variant], [Properties As Variant]) As String
methods.description: Creates a cube file from a PivotTable report connected to an Online Analytical Processing (OLAP) data source.

parameters.name: File
parameters.description: The name of the cube file to be created. It will overwrite the file if it already exists.

parameters.name: Measures
parameters.description: An array of unique names of measures that are to be part of the slice.

parameters.name: Levels
parameters.description: An array of strings. Each array item is a unique level name. It represents the lowest level of a hierarchy that is in the slice.

parameters.name: Members
parameters.description: An array of string arrays. The elements correspond, in order, to the hierarchies represented in the _Levels_ array. Each element is an array of string arrays that consists of the unique names of the top level members in the dimension that are to be included in the slice.

parameters.name: Properties
parameters.description: False results in no member properties being included in the slice. The default value is True.

methods.name: ClearTable
methods.description: The ClearTable method is used for clearing a PivotTable. Clearing PivotTables includes removing all the fields and deleting all filtering and sorting applied to the PivotTables. This method resets the PivotTable to the state it had right after it was created, before any fields were added to it.

methods.name: RowAxisLayout
methods.description: This method is used for simultaneously setting layout options for all existing PivotFields.

parameters.name: RowLayout
parameters.description: Specifies the type of layout row. Can be xlCompactRow, xlTabularRow, or xlOutlineRow.

methods.name: SubtotalLocation
methods.description: This method changes the subtotal location for all existing PivotFields. Changing the subtotal location has an immediate visual effect only for fields in outline form, but it will be set for fields in tabular form as well.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: XlSubtotalLocationType can be either xlAtTop or xlAtBottom.

methods.name: ClearAllFilters
methods.description: The ClearAllFilters method deletes all filters currently applied to the PivotTable. This includes deleting all filters in the PivotFilters collection, removing any manual filtering applied, and setting all PivotFields in the Report Filter area to the default item.

methods.name: ConvertToFormulas
methods.description: The ConvertToFormulas method is used for converting a PivotTable to cube formulas. Read/write Boolean.

parameters.name: ConvertFilters
parameters.description: Contains True or False to indicate the state of the ReportFilter area.

methods.name: ChangeConnection
methods.description: Changes the connection of the specified PivotTable object.

parameters.name: conn
parameters.description: A WorkbookConnection object that represents the new connection for the PivotTable.

methods.name: ChangePivotCache
methods.description: Changes the PivotCache object of the specified PivotTable.

methods.name: AllocateChanges
methods.description: Performs a writeback operation for all edited cells in a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source.

methods.name: CommitChanges
methods.description: Performs a commit operation on the data source of a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source.

methods.name: DiscardChanges
methods.description: Discards all changes in the edited cells of a PivotTable report based on an OLAP data source.

methods.name: RefreshDataSourceValues
methods.description: Retrieves the current values from the data source for all edited cells in a PivotTable report that is in writeback mode.

methods.name: RepeatAllLabels
methods.description: Specifies whether to repeat item labels for all PivotFields in the specified PivotTable.

parameters.name: Repeat
parameters.description: Specifies whether to repeat all field item labels in a PivotTable report.

methods.name: PivotValueCell
methods.signature: PivotValueCell([rowline As Variant], [columnline As Variant]) As PivotValueCell
methods.description: Retrieve the PivotValueCell object for a given PivotTable provided certain row and column indices.

parameters.name: rowline
parameters.description: If of type PivotLine, specifies the PivotLine in the row area that the PivotValueCell is aligned with. If of type Int, specifies the position of the PivotLine on the row area that the PivotValueCell is aligned with. If missing, Empty, Null, or 0 specifies the grand total row.

parameters.name: columnline
parameters.description: If of type PivotLine, specifies the PivotLine in the column area that the PivotValueCell is aligned with. If of type Int, specifies the position of the PivotLine on the column area that the PivotValueCell is aligned with. If missing, Empty, Null or 0 specifies the grand total column.

methods.name: DrillDown
methods.description: Enables you to drill down into the data within an OLAP-based or PowerPivot-based cube hierarchy.

parameters.name: PivotItem
parameters.description: The member from which the drill down is performed.

parameters.name: PivotLine
parameters.description: Specifies the line in the PivotTable where the operation starting member resides. In cases where PivotLine is not specified, defaults to the top PivotLine where the member appears.

methods.name: DrillUp
methods.signature: DrillUp(PivotItem As PivotItem, [PivotLine As Variant], [LevelUniqueName As Variant])
methods.description: Enables you to drill up into the data within an OLAP-based or PowerPivot-based cube hierarchy.

parameters.name: PivotItem
parameters.description: The member from which the drill up is performed.

parameters.name: PivotLine
parameters.description: Specifies the line in the PivotTable where the operation starting member resides. In cases where PivotLine is not specified, defaults to the top PivotLine where the member appears.

parameters.name: LevelUniqueName
parameters.description: The target for a multi-level drill up. The default action, if not specified, is a one level drill up.

methods.name: DrillTo
methods.signature: DrillTo(PivotItem As PivotItem, CubeField As CubeField, [PivotLine As Variant])
methods.description: Enables you to drill to a location within an OLAP-based or PowerPivot-based cube hierarchy.

parameters.name: PivotItem
parameters.description: The member from which the drill operation is performed.

parameters.name: CubeField
parameters.description: The target hierarchy being drilled to.

parameters.name: PivotLine
parameters.description: Specifies the line in the PivotTable where the operation starting member resides. In cases where PivotLine is not specified, defaults to the top PivotLine where the member appears.
